info.title: ProjectX.API
info.description: HTTP API used by the ProjectX Unity client and dedicated game server for authentication and persistent game state.

post.description: Validates an email address and password, then returns a JWT bearer token and the user's preferred language.

200.description: Authentication succeeded and a JWT bearer token was issued.

401.description: The email or password is invalid, or the account is locked out.

429.description: Too many login attempts were made from the same IP address.

post.description:
Issues a fresh one-hour JWT bearer token for the authenticated client or dedicated server during the current token's final five minutes. Refreshing does not revoke the current token, so it remains usable until its original expiry during the handover window.

Required authorization policy: ServerOrClient.

200.description: The session was refreshed and a new JWT bearer token was issued.

401.description: The current JWT is invalid, expired, or belongs to an unavailable account.

403.description: The current JWT is valid but is not yet inside its final five-minute refresh window, or the authenticated role cannot refresh sessions.

post.description:
Adds experience to one progression category and returns the updated total experience and calculated level.

Required authorization policy: ServerPlayerSession.

parameters.name: PlayerSessionId
parameters.description: Opaque player-session credential issued to the dedicated server after one-time ticket redemption.

requestBody.description: Character identifier, experience amount, and progression category.

200.description: Experience was added and the updated progression values are returned.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

get.description:
Returns the persisted ordered inventory slots and capacity for the authenticated user's character.

Required authorization policy: Client.

parameters.name: CharacterId
parameters.description: Identifier of the character whose inventory is requested.

200.description: The character inventory was found and returned.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.description:
Applies item additions, removals, a stack split, or a slot move to the persisted character inventory.

Required authorization policy: ServerPlayerSession.

parameters.name: PlayerSessionId
parameters.description: Opaque player-session credential issued to the dedicated server after one-time ticket redemption.

requestBody.description: Character identifier and inventory operations to apply.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

get.description:
Returns the quest lifecycle state and progress assigned to a character.

Required authorization policy: Client.

parameters.name: CharacterId
parameters.description: Identifier of the character whose quests are requested.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.description:
Creates an accepted quest state for the authenticated user's character.

Required authorization policy: Client.

requestBody.description: Identifier of the quest to accept.

201.description: The quest was accepted and its initial character state is returned.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.description:
Adds a progress increment to an accepted character quest and updates its lifecycle state when the requirement is met.

Required authorization policy: ServerPlayerSession.

parameters.name: PlayerSessionId
parameters.description: Opaque player-session credential issued to the dedicated server after one-time ticket redemption.

requestBody.description: Character quest identifier and progress increment.

200.description: Quest progress was updated and the resulting state is returned.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.description:
Finds an active quest matching a game-server event, applies progress when present, and returns the resulting state.

Required authorization policy: ServerPlayerSession.

parameters.name: PlayerSessionId
parameters.description: Opaque player-session credential issued to the dedicated server after one-time ticket redemption.

requestBody.description: Quest identifier, progress increment, and character identifier reported by the game server.

200.description: The matching active quest was updated, or an empty result is returned when none is active.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.description:
Marks a finished character quest as completed, consumes required collection items, and returns its reward.

Required authorization policy: ServerPlayerSession.

parameters.name: PlayerSessionId
parameters.description: Opaque player-session credential issued to the dedicated server after one-time ticket redemption.

requestBody.description: Identifier of the finished character quest to complete.

200.description: The quest was completed and its reward is returned.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

get.description:
Returns current persistent state, attributes, equipment, and progression levels for a character owned by the authenticated user.

Required authorization policy: ServerPlayerSession.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the character to retrieve.

parameters.name: PlayerSessionId
parameters.description: Opaque player-session credential issued to the dedicated server after one-time ticket redemption.

200.description: The character was found and returned.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.description:
Partially updates persistent health, attributes, equipment, or ammunition state for a character.

Required authorization policy: ServerPlayerSession.

parameters.name: PlayerSessionId
parameters.description: Opaque player-session credential issued to the dedicated server after one-time ticket redemption.

requestBody.description: Character identifier and the optional state fields to update.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

get.description:
Returns the most recently persisted world position and horizontal rotation for the authenticated user's character.

Required authorization policy: Client.

200.description: The latest character transform was found and returned.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.description:
Persists a new world-position snapshot for the authenticated user's character.

Required authorization policy: ServerPlayerSession.

parameters.name: PlayerSessionId
parameters.description: Opaque player-session credential issued to the dedicated server after one-time ticket redemption.

requestBody.description: World position and horizontal rotation to persist.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

get.description:
Returns active crafting recipes for the requested profession, ordered by recipe identifier.

Required authorization policy: ServerOrClient.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Crafting profession used to filter active recipes.

200.description: Matching active crafting recipes were returned.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.summary: Register a dedicated game server session
post.description:
Registers the dedicated server's current direct or Relay allocation and starts a short UTC lease. A new registration replaces the previous session owned by the same server account.

Required authorization policy: Server.

requestBody.description: Transport mode and Relay join code. The join code is required only for Relay sessions.

200.description: The game session was registered and its lease expiry was returned.

403.description: Direct transport is disabled in this environment, or the authenticated principal is not a server.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

post.summary: Renew a dedicated game server session lease
post.description:
Renews an active game-session lease from the current UTC time. An expired lease cannot be revived and the server must register a new session.

Required authorization policy: Server.

requestBody.description: The active game-session identifier assigned to this dedicated server.

200.description: The game-session lease was renewed and its new UTC expiry was returned.

401.description: The game session is invalid, expired, or belongs to another server account.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.summary: Create a one-time game connection ticket
post.description:
Returns the active server's connection information and a random ticket that expires quickly and can be redeemed exactly once. Creating another ticket for the same client and game session replaces the previous ticket.

Required authorization policy: Client.

200.description: A one-time connection ticket was created.

404.description: No active game server session is registered.

429.description: The per-account ticket creation limit of 20 requests per minute was exceeded.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.summary: Redeem a one-time game connection ticket
post.description:
Atomically consumes a ticket assigned to this server session and creates a server-only player-session credential.

Required authorization policy: Server.

requestBody.description: Game-session identifier and one-time connection ticket received during NGO connection approval.

200.description: The ticket was consumed and a player-session credential was issued.

401.description: The ticket is invalid, expired, already consumed, or belongs to another server session.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

post.summary: Revoke a disconnected player's server session
post.description:
Revokes the server-only player-session credential after the corresponding Netcode client disconnects.

Required authorization policy: Server.

requestBody.description: The server-only player-session credential to revoke.

204.description: The credential was revoked or was already unavailable.

400.description: The request is malformed or failed validation.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

get.description:
Returns one localized quest definition in the authenticated user's preferred language.

Required authorization policy: Client.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the quest to retrieve.

200.description: The localized quest definition was found and returned.

404.description: The requested resource was not found.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.

get.description:
Returns all active quest definitions localized to the authenticated user's preferred language.

Required authorization policy: ServerOrClient.

200.description: Active localized quest definitions were returned.

401.description: A valid JWT access token is required.

403.description: The authenticated principal does not satisfy the required authorization policy.
